Drug–Food Interactions with Treatments for Neurological Disorders 
Many clients with neurologic conditions require treatments and medications that can affect their nutritional status. 
It is important for the nurse to identify potential nutritional risks and help plan dietary adjustments with clients. This 
section familiarizes the nurse with some of the more common treatments and medications used for these clients. 
A person’s genetic background strongly influences food and drug interactions, and certain nutritional deficiencies 
alter the gut microbiome, which can alter future medication absorption. Excessive intake of some vitamins can 
reduce the effectiveness of certain drugs, especially those used to treat epilepsy. Understanding the interactions
